settings.providerManagementTip: Manage LLM providers (local or cloud). Set the current active provider, configure failover queues, and test latency. API Key is stored only in the local database.
settings.dataFlowTip: Local provider (Ollama): conversations are fully inferred locally without going through the cloud. Cloud provider: conversations are sent to the corresponding provider via the backend proxy, and the backend automatically performs PII desensitization (phone number/email/ID number). Failover: when the primary provider fails, it automatically switches to the backup provider by priority (non-streaming requests only).
